description: This file defines the 'OceanCard' widget, a reusable customizable card component with different styles (standard and elevated) for Flutter UI development. It encapsulates styling, layout, and optional interactivity features.

classes.name: OceanCard
classes.description: A customizable Flutter widget providing standard and elevated card styles with optional leading/trailing widgets, titles, subtitles, child content, and tap handling.

methods.name: OceanCard.standard
methods.description: Constructor for creating a standard (flat, bordered) OceanCard with optional leading/trailing widgets, title/subtitle, child content, and tap callback.

methods.name: OceanCard.elevated
methods.description: Constructor for creating an elevated (with shadow) OceanCard with similar customization options as 'standard'.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the OceanCard, applying styles and handling tap gestures if provided.
